highlights.label: Median market move → receipt: polling to flashblock stream, 45 + 45 orders.
Live chat evaluation passed on one model after fixing a risk-setting bug (previous run: 13 / 14).
Cross-venue routes × trade sizes, evaluated on each of three observed blocks.
Better gross spread from a split exit: 0.001938 → 0.002542 USDT. Not net or earned profit.

improvements.change: Testnet only → mainnet v4 + testnet v3
improvements.meaning: Mainnet receipt confirmed. Mainnet caps, funding and guards were unset in the 3 November read.

improvements.change: Rules only → optional buy / sell / hold proposals
improvements.meaning: 29 local engine tests; two recorded-price replay windows. Off by default; never traded on chain. One replay trade ended at −0.024241 USDT before model-call cost.
Risk settings fixed, positions and P&L checked. One small run on one model, not a reliability estimate. Public-site chat needs operator configuration.
Testnet polling versus stream, 45 + 45 orders. Own market and older vault; not current mainnet execution latency.
400 + 400 mainnet reads; batching reduced read latency. Does not measure trade execution.

improvements.change: v3 limits → v4 loss budget, share cap, cooldown and strategy pin
improvements.meaning: Implemented and tested, with a verifiable on-chain log. These controls must be configured; the mainnet deployment alone does not enable them.
Broader hand-picked mutation set. This is not exhaustive vulnerability coverage or an external audit.

improvements.change: Single routes → finer sizing and split exits
improvements.meaning: 565 baseline samples had zero positive net estimates. Split exit breaks even at about 58,062 hypothetical total gas. No cross-venue executor or actual fills.

improvements.change: Top-of-book scenarios → depth, fees, minimum orders and time splits
improvements.meaning: Fresh exchange hedges were negative. Historical 5-bp replay changed from +0.148032 to −0.174533 USDT across chronological segments. No sustained or realized profit.
